content.text: left Jerusalem unto the broad wall
to make an error to it
that from all places ye must return to us
from the lower parts of the place
and the other half of them
every one with with his weapon for water
unto us? Then held they their peace,
and took an oath of them,
that they might be reckoned by genealogy.
of those that had been carried away,
those that were reckoned by genealogy,
therefore were they, as polluted, put
that they might instruct in the words of the Law
of them that were come again
for them out of the rock
them that they should go in
which thou hadst lift up thine hand to give them
so that they had the dominion
over them: yet when they returned,
against them, that thou mightest bring them again
in the hand of thy Prophets
also from the house of Gilgal,
made their voice to be heard
into them out of the fields
had made to dwell with them
of them, and plucked off their hair,
